interpretation: 30 total from this HF campaign; earlier unrelated pilots are not counted.
evidence_scope: Human source-evidence audit. Planned resource lanes and verifier ideas are hypotheses until each pinned PR passes bootstrap and controls.

primary.head: bc3753dfb3020e651c7cc48d908f820996b65278
primary.verification_idea: Actual CPU/CUDA transfers, dtype and tied-weight behavior; test transfer/cache controls. Do not encode the PR title's 4-5x speed claim.

primary.head: d87972c1b8a33322160b7f0f7061af1bd475b41c
primary.verification_idea: Dense numerical and gradient reference, ignored labels and varying chunk sizes; fresh-process peak CUDA allocation with calibrated margin.

primary.head: 29a6fd360f1feeeadb66103ec048fa869dfd117d
primary.verification_idea: Initialize/reset state in separate processes; verify explicit and environment-driven configuration survives the right lifecycle.

primary.head: 472c7f9c924674c0ced18bc608a737191466334f
primary.verification_idea: Tiny optimizer loop; independent expected parameter interpolation and sync cadence; incompatible options rejected.

primary.head: 1b9ce2da24f01a0d9b28d8177b540e5f048640d3
primary.verification_idea: Real local Dataset.map/cache reuse with an unpicklable trainer field; detect retriggered tokenization and fingerprint drift.

primary.head: 43e01410a9229a5704882bf2ef53002914606fd5
primary.verification_idea: Tiny compatible model, independent fused-QKV key/shape conversion, alpha scaling, load/unload and numerical output checks.

primary.head: 21cab59ff4aa2359aa65dc0d0e8a889c6c91031f
primary.verification_idea: Real CUDA autocast/backward/optimizer behavior plus documented scaler options; bounded compatibility controls for other backends.

primary.head: f88ad8b2dd59e55de76f15d17e8df3933af2a4ac
primary.verification_idea: Real supported float8 storage on CUDA, higher-precision reference, restoration after adapter use and merge; no native FP8 GEMM claim.

primary.head: 5d907dbb97370b0153f9ad4e58216d3c28150c1a
primary.verification_idea: Dense value/gradient reference, temperature and masks, entropy, varied shapes and isolated peak memory; follow final diff, not stale PR body.

primary.head: e294047ca750a3267a0f93caba817c0115d1bc4c
primary.verification_idea: Offline logging transport boundary, actual trainer metric flow and disabled-logging path; no external telemetry service needed.

primary.head: 0512050e8623069b58d50381f6c1929321340dd0
primary.verification_idea: Instrument real factory instances; verify construction counts, reset/reuse, pool growth and per-rollout tool bindings.

primary.head: a23f77dc1132fe353a8dfdd192c4135af3038636
primary.verification_idea: Local tokenizer/templates with the actual compatible Transformers parser, streamed prefixes, reasoning and tool calls; test documented legacy path.

primary.head: ef2ebc4b34cdd49fd8b81215ff86fbdbb68c1dd1
primary.verification_idea: Explicit migration requirements across the actual changed APIs, replacement behavior and targeted rejection of removed forms.

primary.head: a624c49ab0e1be4ec34655603c512bb198764579
primary.verification_idea: Install compatible Liger/Triton; compare real loss and adapter gradients against unfused DPO; reject adapted LM-head combinations.

primary.head: 176f516005569cabd26b2e9e9d7aa5553c6218e9
primary.verification_idea: Two ranks, tiny language model, real sharded units and forward/backward numerics; tied/untied embeddings and reshard policy.

primary.head: ba757be6c587e6a68bca7a91f715c434d291a7db
primary.verification_idea: Real compilation and sharding hooks on two ranks; compiled/eager output and gradient agreement, hook execution and bounded completion.
